title: CueFX stand-in render result (POST /api/standin, contract/HTTP.md)
description: Make (grey-ball layout + code-drawn stand-in) and Merge of one cue on its clip, no LTX. `files` are URLs on the same server (root-relative). The hard comp is Merge's final.mp4 (footage + stand-in); the element video is the stand-in alone on black at plate size.

make_key.description: the Make cache key (cuefx.make_key), as the CLI prints it

effect_range.description: the frames Make and Merge used, [start, end): the cue's effect_range grown to cover the entrance, then trimmed (CONTRACT.md 7.6)

hardcomp_preview.description: hard comp, H.264 yuv420p, plate size, the plate's fps and frame count; shown inline

hardcomp_download.description: the same hard comp as a download (Content-Disposition: attachment)

element_download.description: the element video exactly as scripts/make_element_video.py writes it (H.264 4:4:4 CRF 0), download

layout_download.description: layout.mp4 exactly as Make writes it (grey ball on black, canvas size, window frames), download

cached.description: true when this exact cue was rendered before and nothing ran

warnings.description: plain-text notes from Make and Merge (degrade, don't fail)

timings_s.description: optional. Seconds per stage of the render that made these files (the same numbers when `cached`): landmarks (behind ranges only), make (0 when an earlier Make was reused), merge, total; and, once element.mp4 has been requested, element_layers and element. 0 = the stage did not run.
